name: Marham Kharish
indication_description:
Marham Kharish is indicated in-
  • Scabies
  • Itching
  • Pustular
  • Piles
  • Eczema
  • Proriasis
  • Ring worm
  • Skin eruption and burn
pharmacology_description: Marham Kharish is a unique combination of Camphor (Cinnamomum camphora), Henna (Lawsonia inermis), Catechu (Acacia catechu) and others natural ingredients. It acts as antiseptic, anti-inflammatory and anti-microbial. Marham Kharish is very effective in scabies, itching, pustular, piles, boils, eczema and proriasis.
dosage_description: Rub gently the affected area and 2 to 4 times daily or as directed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in proper dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Keep from light. Keep in cool and dry place.
